test_cases.path_step: The Teacher deletes an existing file by locating it in the file tree, clicking its 'Delete' button, and confirming the action in the confirmation dialog.
test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 5: COURSE STRUCTURE MANAGEMENT (DELETION & ORGANIZATION) - Phase 2: Manage and Delete Files
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher Deletes Existing File from Course
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher (GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com) is logged into the system and has navigated to the 'Files' tab of a course that contains an existing file. A file named 'syllabus.pdf' exists within the course file tree.
test_cases.expected_result: The file 'syllabus.pdf' is deleted from the course's file tree. The system displays the updated file structure, confirming the successful deletion of the file. A confirmation message should be displayed to the Teacher.
test_cases.post_condition: The file 'syllabus.pdf' is permanently removed from the course. The Teacher's session remains active, and they are on the 'Files' tab of the Course Details Page.

test_steps.step: Click on the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course in the Course List.
Click on the 'Files' tab to manage course files.
Locate 'syllabus.pdf' in the File Tree and click its 'Delete' button.
Confirm the deletion in the confirmation dialog.
